market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: KKR is the defending IPL champion and a strong franchise with multiple titles. In a 10-team T20 league, even the worst team has at least a ~5% chance, so 1.1% is irrationally low. No team-specific negative news justifies this price.
evidence_points: KKR won the 2024 IPL, showing recent success and strong squad management.
T20 cricket has high variance, but top teams consistently have win probabilities in the 10-15% range pre-season.
No credible reports suggest KKR will be uncompetitive or non-existent in 2026; they are a stable, well-funded franchise.
sources_consulted: General understanding of T20 league competitive balance
